title: Reading choices and writer reflection
titlePs: د لوست ټاکنه او د لیکنې کتنه
intro: A reader can choose a story, poem or information book. Tell what you enjoy and link it with something you know. When you read your own writing aloud, listen for one thing that works and one that could be clearer.
support: کیسه، نظم یا معلوماتي کتاب وټاکئ. د خوښې لامل ووایئ. خپله لیکنه په غږ ولولئ او وګورئ چې کوم ځای روښانه دی.
text:
Story: The Lost Ball
Ben looked under a bench. A red ball rolled out. He took it back to his friend.
Poem: Rain on My Window
Drip, drop, splash and stop.
Drip, drop, on the top.
Information: How Seeds Grow
A seed needs water. A root may grow down first.
model: One reader may like the rain poem because of its repeated sounds. Another may choose the seed text to find a fact. Explain your choice using a detail from the text.
activity: Choose one of the three short texts. Point to a detail that made you want to read it again.
adult: Offer the three short texts. Ask the learner to choose one, give a reason and listen to a partner’s choice.
adultPs: له ماشومه وغواړئ چې یوه لیکنه وټاکي او د ټاکنې دلیل ووایي. بیا دې د ملګري دلیل واوري.

rounds.prompt: Which title is the information book?
rounds.hint: Look for the title that tells how something works.
rounds.instruction: انګلیسي پوښتنه ولولئ او برخې په ترتیب وټاکئ.

rounds.prompt: Which pair could begin the sentence “___ ___ the rain poem because of its sounds”?
rounds.hint: Start with yourself, then tell how you felt about it.
rounds.instruction: انګلیسي پوښتنه ولولئ او برخې په ترتیب وټاکئ.

rounds.prompt: Which title invites you to hear a rhyme?
rounds.instruction: انګلیسي پوښتنه ولولئ او برخې په ترتیب وټاکئ.

rounds.prompt: In How Seeds Grow, which fact would help someone decide what to give a seed?
rounds.hint: Look for the fact about what a seed needs.
rounds.instruction: انګلیسي پوښتنه ولولئ او برخې په ترتیب وټاکئ.

rounds.prompt: Which reason names something you can find in the rain poem?
choices: I like the repeated drip, drop.
I like the photo of a bird.
answer: I like the repeated drip, drop.
rounds.hint: Find a feature printed in the poem.
rounds.instruction: انګلیسي پوښتنه ولولئ او برخې په ترتیب وټاکئ.

rounds.prompt: Ben took the ball back to his friend. What detail could make that story ending clearer?
rounds.hint: Choose a detail about the people in this scene.
rounds.instruction: انګلیسي پوښتنه ولولئ او برخې په ترتیب وټاکئ.

rounds.prompt: Which note explains a reading choice?
choices: I chose the seed text because I want to plant beans.
answer: I chose the seed text because I want to plant beans.
rounds.hint: Look for a choice and a reason.
rounds.instruction: انګلیسي پوښتنه ولولئ او برخې په ترتیب وټاکئ.

tasks: Choose a book to read or hear. Write its title.
Choose a story and a poem from a shelf. What made you pick each?
Tell someone about a story or poem you liked.
Complete in your own words: This book made me think of ...
Read a short piece of your own writing aloud. Mark a part you are proud of.
Write a note recommending something you read at home.
Try an information book. Say what you learnt and whether you would read another.
Choose one real text independently. Write a reason for choosing it.
Read: The Lost Ball ends when Ben returns the ball. Write a sentence about a time you helped someone.
Read one of your own pieces aloud. Explain one word you chose and one thing you would improve.
